title: Week 5 Practice: Geometry Foundations
description: Use this set to recall core geometry formulas and translate diagrams into relationships.

questions.question: What is the area of a triangle with base 10 cm and height 6 cm?
A right triangle has legs 9 and 12. What is the hypotenuse?
The angles of a triangle are $x$, $x$, and $80^\circ$. What is $x$?
questions.explanation: Since triangle angles sum to $180^\circ$, $2x+80=180$, so $x=50$.

questions.question: A rectangle has length 9 and width 4. What is its perimeter?
Opposite angles in a parallelogram are equal.
questions.explanation: This is one of the key properties of parallelograms.

questions.question: The area of a square with side 7 is 14.
Find the area of a trapezoid with bases 8 and 14 and height 5.
One angle of a parallelogram is $72^\circ$. What are the other three angles?
questions.explanation: Opposite angles are equal and adjacent angles are supplementary.
